name: KitchenMate RO Undersink Active silver Technology
summary: The ZeroB Kitchenmate RO+ESS Water Purifier is a sleek under-the-sink water purifier designed for modern modular kitchens. Its compact design saves valuable countertop space while the complimentary long-reach faucet offers convenient access to purified water.
features: Elegant design that enhances kitchen aesthetics
Hydropneumatic (HN) tank for consistent water pressure
Auto tank fill for uninterrupted purified water supply
Delivers up to 9 liters of purified water per hour
Low power consumption of just 30 Watts
